listing.name: The Simpsons Game / TheSimpsonsGameRecomp
listing.summary: Register a completed The Simpsons Game Windows player through its supported waiting launcher and preserve its external saves.

steps.title: Complete the title’s preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted complete The Simpsons Game Recompiled Windows copy with matching launcher, simpsons.exe, runtime libraries and native_shaders. Complete the official upstream install from your own Xbox 360 ISO before attachment, retaining gamedata/default.xex and the complete data including movies. USA title ID 45410809 is the main target; Europe is separately described as less tested, with no inherited qualification. Select the correct AVX2 build, or the upstream NoAVX2 build for a compatible older SSE4.2 CPU. Portcove does not extract originals or install host runtimes.

steps.title: Attach the completed supported native entry
steps.instruction: Select simpsons-launcher.exe with its complete flat package directory as working directory and --play as its literal argument. This documented entry uses the same preparation checks, settings, save protection and environment as the upstream Play button, then waits for game_proc. It starts the matching game with explicit game-data and user-data roots; do not substitute an extractor, private helper or the Linux script. Keep the established Windows C++ and graphics driver dependencies.

steps.title: Keep the actual session and successor boundary
steps.instruction: The supported --play launcher waits for its normal game process. Upstream owns its independent update mechanism: it may replace launcher/engine files and ask you to restart, or leave a separately named new launcher if replacement fails. Close actual players and companions before deliberate replacement; preserve old working files, then review and relink changed selected bytes. This registration does not invoke, authenticate or manage that updater.

steps.title: Review Play and preserve external ownership
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact selected native executable, established CWD and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Upstream and you own preparation, runtime replacement and recovery. Removing registration preserves every external file. Portcove offers no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion. Close actual players and companions, keep the old complete working copy and every effective data root, then review and relink changed selected bytes.

steps.title: Retain the complete creating copy and actual data
steps.instruction: Keep the complete runtime, gamedata and every effective data root. Windows player saves/cache default to %LOCALAPPDATA%/simpsons with a home/AppData/Local fallback; the launcher passes that effective path explicitly. simpsons.toml is beside the game executable. Preserve launcher.json, art, mods, backups, diagnostics, logs, shader caches, native shaders and any custom engine/lib/data configuration. Upstream Play may repair saves and create backups; those operations remain upstream-owned, not Portcove backup/rollback promises. Keep private profiles and credentials private. Project GPLv3, ReXGlue/Xenia BSD-3-Clause, XenonRecomp MIT and other notices remain separate from the original game and assets.

warnings: Use only an actual copy and components you are permitted to use. Preserve all originals, runtime companions, saves, settings, mods, caches, logs, backups and custom roots. Another executable may share them. Static source/metadata and reusable fixtures are not gameplay, real-save, installed-client, Supported or protected acceptance.
